Having worked in the medical field myself, I know how draining and overwhelming it can be.

However, during my most recent phone consultation, I was seen (or rather, not seen) by a doctor who was completely neglectful. She prescribed me medication without physically seeing me or asking enough questions, and unfortunately, my condition worsened afterward. I find this kind of approach — diagnosing and prescribing without proper assessment, and showing no compassion — deeply concerning and unacceptable.

That said, I want to highlight that not everyone in this practice is like that. I would’ve gladly given five stars for the Scottish-accented doctor with East Asian features — he has always been incredibly kind, thorough, and attentive every time I’ve seen him. The receptionists have also been consistently helpful and respectful. They don’t deserve to be affected by this negative
